topic: How big the observable universe is
script: The universe is 13.8 billion years old, but we can see farther than 13.8 billion light-years. That is because space has been expanding while the light traveled toward us. The edge of what we can see is now about 46 billion light-years away in every direction. So the observable universe is about 93 billion light-years across.
